drawRule: Training only: 120 plies or third repetition; live rules unchanged
teacherSearch: iterative-deepening MaxN, depth 4, beam 3 (root 6), 450-node budget, Zobrist transpositions, tempo-aware walls and progress-preserving pawn selection
opening: 2-10 seeded legal actions; 35% random legal walls, otherwise selective actions
target: 75% teacher MaxN utility + 25% actual self-play outcome; draws uniform
split: whole game id modulo 10: 80/10/10; canonical duplicate removal across splits
augmentation: all three evaluation perspectives per state, including all relative sides to move
optimizer: AdamW minibatch 32, initial learning rate 0.002, decay 0.97 per epoch, weight decay 0.0001, hidden dropout 25%
strengthStatus: Experimental, locally trained; no state-of-the-art or ELO claim.
